post.caption: Moss agate contains no moss at all. In many stones, manganese or iron oxides form the shapes. Dendrite comes from the Greek word for tree. Mineral water seeping through cracks grows those branching shapes. They can look so like plants that they pass for fossils. It lacks the banding of true agate, but the name stuck. Cutters shape it into smooth domes called cabochons. It is about 6.5 to 7 on the Mohs scale, like quartz. Mocha stone, its old name, points to a Red Sea port. That same port gave coffee the word mocha.
